reviewed_invariants: MSHR writeback payload is accepted before a read can overwrite its shared buffer
MSHR allocation and response ownership initialize all live payloads
Compressed cache tags retain the full legal RAM address and reject high addresses
Fetch tags retain all non-index bits including bit 31
PRF write priority remains highest-lane wins and x0 remains zero

ROB payload fields are initialized at allocation before valid retirement or recovery
